set i1 1
  set i2 2
  binary scan $x c* L
  foreach {a b} $L {
    set i1 [expr (($i2<<3) + $a) & 0x7FFFFFFF]
    set i2 [expr (($i1<<3) + $b) & 0x7FFFFFFF]
  }
  list $i1 $i2

        SELECT 1, randomblob(1000)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT x+1, randomblob(1000) FROM r
        LIMIT 20000
    )
    SELECT count(*), sum(length(y)) FROM r GROUP BY (x%5);
